verdict.rationale: Docs confirm spending controls can block merchant categories, countries, merchant IDs, and card presence at authorization time, and real-time authorization webhooks allow custom logic (e.g., single-merchant locks). However, evidence does not explicitly confirm true allowlist mode (vs. blocklist-only) for MCCs nor a native single-merchant lock feature — the latter appears achievable only via custom webhook logic, not a first-class control. missing for 10: explicit allowlist support for MCCs, a dedicated single-merchant-lock control, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these controls work as described at authorization time.
